generation.scope: On every polynomial-growth window a periodic sequence of stable equal-dimension Kronecker arrows is determined among all periodic sequences by any one arrow, up to vertex gauge and scaling. In particular distinct periodic cycles of oriented two-dimensional quadrics cannot intersect at a common phase. A primitive cycle of length 4m induces a simple of vertex dimension 2m with exact normalized grading stabilizer μ_m.
